smartDecision.decision: Run read-only Foundation consistency pilot after freeze lift.
smartDecision.whyThisStepNow: It verifies the company, chart and setup context with low risk and gives the book a reliable Foundation boundary before the agent resumes writes.
smartDecision.risk: Low if strictly read-only; medium if the UI enters edit mode or a dialog asks for confirmation.

stopIf: A page enters a write/editor state unexpectedly.
